commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin ({2}{U}{B}{R} 4/5 legendary Human Wizard // Avatar Wizard; Final Fantasy, set fin, released 2025-06-13; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Front: whenever Kefka enters or attacks, each player discards a card, then you draw a card for each card type among the discarded cards; {8}: each opponent sacrifices a permanent, transform (sorcery speed). Back: flying; whenever an opponent loses life during your turn, draw that many. Plan (owner blueprint 2026-10-14): repeat Kefka's enter/attack trigger (Harmonic Prodigy doubles it; Essence Flux and Displacer Kitten blink; Phantasmal Image, Phyrexian Metamorph, Molten Duplication and Saw in Half copy; Gogo, Mysterious Mime adds a second attack trigger), give haste (Anger discarded to Kefka with a Mountain, Arena of Glory, Gogo), and convert discards with Tinybones, Bauble Burglar and Waste Not. Secondary compact wins: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation / Tainted Pact and Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond / Lotus Petal + Brain Freeze / Wheel of Fortune / Jeska's Will. Candidate adds Dualcaster Mage lines with Molten Duplication, Saw in Half and Essence Flux.
protected_core: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (cEDH; owner-approved), unchanged. Game Changers: 20 in both baseline and candidate (Ad Nauseam, Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Gamble, Grim Monolith, Imperial Seal, Jeska's Will, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Necropotence, Orcish Bowmasters, Rhystic Study, Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). The owner's decisions file records multiple 2026 Kefka tournament top cuts including wins; EDHTop16 one-year: 1396 entries, conversion 0.196.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Kefka's Oracle: the one add uses owner spine copy cards and loops Kefka enter triggers with Harmonic Prodigy. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the registry Archidekt exports, candidate/baseline): Kess, Dissident Mage 80/80; Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge 78/78; Inalla, Archmage Ritualist 72/73 (Inalla runs Kefka itself in its 99); Evelyn, the Covetous 67/68. The overlap is the cEDH staple core (fast mana, tutors, free counters, Oracle/Breach). Kefka-unique against all four in the candidate: Anger, Diabolic Intent, Dualcaster Mage, Gogo, Mysterious Mime, Molten Duplication, Phantasmal Image, Phyrexian Metamorph, Starting Town, Tinybones, Bauble Burglar, Waste Not. The swap lowers overlap: Culling the Weak is shared with Inalla and Evelyn; Dualcaster Mage is in none of the four. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Animate Dead, Dauthi Voidwalker, Geth's Grimoire, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Laughing Mad, Liliana's Caress, Megrim, Monument to Endurance, Nightscape Familiar, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, Strionic Resonator, Windfall, Mountain, Swamp, Xander's Lounge, Exotic Orchard, Cyclonic Rift, Opposition Agent, Psychosis Crawler, Cursed Totem, Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun, the Banishing Knack/Retraction Helix package, The One Ring, Birgi, Faerie Mastermind, Wan Shi Tong, extra discard payoffs) are not re-added. Owner-direction flag: Dualcaster Mage's Molten Duplication kill does not require Kefka, which is close to the owner's reason for rejecting the Floodcaller bounce package; disclosed for owner decision.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 library cards were reviewed (99 rows; 1x Island; 100 distinct names). Every baseline card is owner-directed (80 retained + 19 added on 2026-10-14); only some are explicit keeps (Gogo, Hexing Squelcher, Phyrexian Metamorph, Tinybones, Waste Not, the blueprint spine). Candidate roles: 28 lands; 14 creatures (Anger, Displacer Kitten, Dualcaster Mage, Gogo, Harmonic Prodigy, Hexing Squelcher, Orcish Bowmasters, Phantasmal Image, Phyrexian Metamorph, Ragavan, Simian Spirit Guide, Thassa's Oracle, Tinybones, Valley Floodcaller); 26 instants and 13 sorceries; 13 noncreature artifacts (Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, Lion's Eye Diamond, two Talismans, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, Wishclaw Talisman); 5 enchantments (Mystic Remora, Necropotence, Rhystic Study, Underworld Breach, Waste Not). Stack suite: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Flusterstorm, Swan Song, Mental Misstep, Mindbreak Trap, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deflecting Swat. Rituals after the cut: Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Rite of Flame.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 28 lands unchanged (13 Mountain-subtype sources: 4 duals plus 9 fetches; bounded). 71 nonland cards in the candidate; curve MV0 6, MV1 21, MV2 23, MV3 13, MV4 6, MV5 2; average nonland MV 1.97 (baseline: one more MV1, one fewer MV3). Red pips: Dualcaster Mage needs {R}{R}.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Twelve stack-interaction cards (most free or one mana), Hexing Squelcher and Cavern of Souls for uncounterable Kefka, Orcish Bowmasters, Toxic Deluge, Into the Flood Maw / Chain of Vapor / Otawara bounce. Weak to graveyard hate against Anger, Breach and Demonic Counsel delirium. Dualcaster Mage adds an instant-speed copy of a removal spell or tutor.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Kefka, Court Mage general 5867/32536, upgraded 337/2908, optimized 772/2427, cEDH 497/2232; EDHTop16 one-year Kefka entries 252, top-cut conversion 0.1706 (field 0.196); live Scryfall batch; Commander Spellbook almost-included for the baseline (147-5487, 147-500)
material_candidates.role: {1}{R}{R} 2/2 Human Wizard with flash: when it enters, copy target instant or sorcery spell; you may choose new targets for the copy.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Culling the Weak is not an owner explicit keep or blueprint card (one of the 80 retained baseline slots): {B} instant, sacrifice a creature as an additional cost, add {B}{B}{B}{B}. It is dead without a creature on the battlefield (P(at least one MV<=2 creature seen) 0.4115 on turn 1 to 0.6075 on turn 6, bounded test), makes only black, and Pass C questioned it against a third colored rock. EDHREC cEDH 861/2232; EDHTop16 one-year 557 entries, conversion 0.1867 (field 0.196). Alternative cut (staged): Diabolic Intent, a sacrifice-a-creature tutor to hand that finds either combo half or Thassa's Oracle.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Turns three owner-added Kefka spine cards already in the 99 into two-card lines: Molten Duplication (Commander Spellbook 147-5487, infinite hasty tokens, a same-turn combat kill for 5 mana), Saw in Half (147-500, infinite tokens; haste via Anger) and Essence Flux (147-4598, infinite enter triggers). It is a Wizard, so Harmonic Prodigy doubles its enter trigger; the spare copy may target Kefka (CR 707.10c), giving a Kefka enter trigger (blink via Essence Flux, or a hasty token Kefka via Molten Duplication) on every iteration. It is also a flash instant-speed copy of Gamble, Demonic Tutor, Toxic Deluge or an opponent's spell when the combo is not assembled.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Commander Spellbook 6 -> 9. Data are neutral to slightly against: EDHREC cEDH 497/2232 vs Culling the Weak 861/2232, and EDHTop16 one-year conversion 0.1706 (252 entries) vs Culling 0.1867 (557 entries); the 0.016 gap is inside sampling noise (difference standard error about 0.027) and both are below the 0.196 field. Bounded: P(Dualcaster and at least one partner seen) 0.0123 on turn 1 to 0.0367 on turn 6 before tutors. Owner-direction flag: the owner rejected a 'dedicated Valley Floodcaller bounce-combo package' as a generic combo that consumes additional slots and does not require Kefka. Dualcaster is one slot that uses three cards already in the deck for Kefka's copy plan, and it integrates Kefka through Harmonic Prodigy, but its Molten Duplication kill also works without Kefka. The owner must decide; the zero-swap baseline remains available.
material_candidates.reason: Rejected for this commander-first exact 100: generic Dualcaster lines do not justify cutting Culling the Weak fast black mana. The alternative is not silently an additional approved swap.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Kefka, Court Mage general 3181/32536, upgraded 257/2908, optimized 401/2427, cEDH 316/2232; live Scryfall batch; Pass C's requested test (NEEDS TESTING +Entomb/-Demonic Counsel; also against Borne Upon a Wind)
material_candidates.role: {B} instant: search your library for a card and put it into your graveyard.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Demonic Counsel is an owner addition accepted over Opposition Agent in the 2026-10-14 adversarial second pass ('efficient proactive tutor'). The 99 has no Demon, so it is dead without delirium (four card types in your graveyard); bounded delirium proxy turn 4 0.0659 lower / 0.4229 upper, turn 6 0.111 / 0.5463. EDHREC cEDH 549/2232. Alternative cut: Borne Upon a Wind, an owner baseline card that gives flash to Wheel of Fortune, Gamble and the copy sorceries and draws a card (EDHREC cEDH 1786/2232).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Bins Anger before Kefka is cast, so Kefka has haste the turn it lands if you control a Mountain-subtype land; it also adds a type for delirium and can bin a Reanimate target.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Bounded: Anger-or-Entomb plus a Mountain-subtype source by turn 5 rises from 0.0863 to 0.1642 (turn 1 0.0413 -> 0.0804). The gain is small in absolute terms, and Kefka's own enter-trigger discard already bins Anger in the native line. Entomb tutors nothing to hand and exposes the card to graveyard hate (Anger's haste ends if it is exiled). Demonic Counsel becomes a two-mana any-card tutor once Kefka triggers and fetchlands have filled the graveyard; Borne Upon a Wind is the deck's flash enabler. Spellbook 6 -> 6 for both.
material_candidates.reason: The measured gain on the haste window is small and it does not beat either named cut.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Two quality-positive commander-first changes, not a five-swap padded list. Direct two-generic Wizardcycling selects among existing Prodigy/Gogo/Floodcaller/Oracle early without the old delirium gate, while Sakashima enables permanent Kefka clone and legend exception for retained copy package. The deliberately owner-added Demonic Counsel broad late tutor and deliberately retained Metamorph three-mana-plus-life artifact versatility are genuinely lost. Culling fast black ramp, 28 printed lands and cEDH win conditions remain. Printed Ad Nauseam total mana-value exposure +3.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: OFF-RANKING: Spark Double (staged, rejected against the owner keep Gogo), Electroduplicate (dominated by Molten Duplication).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Graveyard/delirium package: Entomb bins Anger and DRC surveils into delirium, which is the only reason to keep Demonic Counsel. REJECTED: it would cut Demonic Counsel (the card the package is meant to enable) and an owner explicit keep; the bounded Anger-window gain is small.

Rejected two-swap exact-100 challenge: unconditional Wizardcycling helps Kefka, but Generator Servant requires surviving a turn and removes Culling's fast black burst from the final cEDH mana configuration.

Selected two-swap coherent package: immediate Wizardcycling plus persistent Kefka legend-bypass clone, while explicitly losing delirium broad tutor and Metamorph's flexible artifact-copy/three generic plus two life mode.

low_swap_heightened_audit.no_two_package_reason: Only one credible multi-slot package exists: Entomb + Dragon's Rage Channeler, the one pair whose value depends on each other (delirium for Demonic Counsel and Anger in the graveyard). Every other candidate works alone and its single-slot test settles it. Dualcaster Mage plus a second copy card (Twinflame, Flesh Duplicate) only adds redundancy; Grinding Station is a generic Breach line. So no second package is credible.
low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C requested +Entomb against Demonic Counsel and against Borne Upon a Wind; both are staged as complete 100s. The Culling the Weak slot was tested against a third rock (Talisman of Indulgence, staged as the fallback) and against Dualcaster Mage (selected). The Dualcaster add is also staged with the alternative cut Diabolic Intent.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Culling the Weak is a black-only ritual that needs a creature, while three owner spine cards (Molten Duplication, Saw in Half, Essence Flux) each sit one card away from a two-card infinite (Commander Spellbook almost-included 147-5487, 147-500, 147-4598).
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: One genuine swap, +Dualcaster Mage -Culling the Weak, on mechanics; adoption data are neutral to slightly against it (disclosed). Every other challenger either cuts an owner keep without clearly beating it, is generic, or is marginal. RESEARCH_ONLY.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: One no-trailing-newline 100-card TXT copied exactly from Oct14 owner baseline with two named substitutions only. Exactly one commander, 100 singleton names, 28 printed lands, no illegal or off-Grixis card; raw SHA-256 pinned and independently revalidated against live Oct24 all-100 Oracle. No other card changes.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: All 99 support cards (28 printed lands, retained fast mana including Culling, Kefka blink/clone, Anger, Waste Not/Tinybones, Oracle/Breach and protective interaction) were reconciled against the October 14 baseline and 44 staged distinct 100-card full-deck hypotheses; extra removals must beat tutor breadth, colored acceleration, clone utility and cEDH tempo, not chase five swaps.
open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Two independent commander-specific roles survive comprehensive adversarial whole-100 alternatives. Additional Generator Servant/Culling loses black burst and removal resiliency, Dualcaster introduces Kefka-independent kill, third clone/card swaps strip protected identity, and MDFC/land changes worsen colored speed; therefore no honest unmanufactured third-through-fifth changes remain.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Generator requires a turn of survival and cannot produce U/B/R; the retained Culling supports burst black mana in an existing creature-heavy opening. Both were evaluated in exact whole-100 alternatives.
Twinflame duplicates one short-lived Kefka ETB role already met by Molten Duplication; it does not justify removing the existing copy spell, and Dualcaster combo homogenization is not selected.

open_ended_optimization_audit.no_credible_larger_package_reason: Staged whole-100 three-swap stress configurations with Fire Covenant for Toxic Deluge, Generator Servant for Culling the Weak, or Irma/Chameleon for an owner-retained card. Every additional change imposes greater removal speed, colored-cost, low-curve Ad Nauseam, tutor or clone-utility losses and lacks positive net commander-first justification; the larger tested alternatives remain research hypotheses, not owner-presentable wins.
